primary_rule: Retain EV_8 unless an affirmative technical defect is documented independently of treatment outcomes.
technical_exclusion_criteria: Confirmed GSM/BioSample/SRX/SRR or condition/batch/quantification-file identity mismatch
Confirmed duplicated biological sample or repeated sequencing represented as independent cultures
Unreadable, incomplete, or corrupted Salmon quantification; missing, nonfinite, or negative expression estimates
Confirmed incompatible sequencing or library metadata that invalidates the common quantification representation
Severe quantification failure supported by both an extreme efficiency proxy and independent technical provenance
Catastrophic expression-distribution abnormality supported by independent evidence of technical failure
insufficient_alone: High sequencing depth or estimated-count total
Distinct biology or weaker treatment separation
Any later differential-expression or GSEA result
distance_method: Euclidean nearest-neighbor distance in the first two PCs, divided by the median nearest-neighbor distance across all 16 samples; repeat on all, top-5000, and top-2000 condition-blind feature sets; also report distances within batch.
quantification_proxy_note: Salmon NumReads sum divided by ENA read_count is a cross-sample descriptive ratio only. ENA read_count and Salmon estimated fragments may use different read/fragment units; this is not an absolute mapping rate.
